feNNen Skybar cover options

Five directions built from your own photos and the hand-and-glass cutout, all at 1920 × 1005 with the same structure as the current cover: the message on top, a raised glass in front.

Headlines are set in Beautique Display Condensed and the subheader in Acumin Pro. When those fonts aren't installed on the viewing device, Instrument Serif and Archivo stand in.

The crop guide marks what a desktop Facebook Page cover hides (top and bottom bands) and what phones trim at the sides. All text sits inside the area visible on both.
